card.name: Punctuation before listed conditions or sections
card.fires_on: The word "of" in "Treatment of" section headings, and commas after "renal impairment" in warning lists. It also fires on a heading word such as "Chronic" that follows a dose range.

modes.label: Comma after impairment
modes.description: A comma after "renal (or hepatic) impairment" in a warning list, just before the next risk condition.

modes.label: Treatment of heading
modes.description: The word "of" in a numbered dosing heading such as "Treatment of Edema" or "Treatment of Hypertension".

modes.label: Table row heading
modes.description: The first word of a new indication row in a dosing table, right after a dose duration.
